svg.title: Tiered hybrid recovery topology
svg.desc: Topology showing Azure and factory VMware workloads classified by recovery objectives and routed to backup, Site Recovery, native replication, and an orchestration runbook.

g.aria-label: business impact classification: azure-workloads to recovery-tiers
dependency and failure mapping: vmware-workloads to recovery-tiers
orchestrated workload recovery: recovery-tiers to site-recovery
restore sequence evidence: backup to runbook

svg.text: Workload tiers map to Azure Backup, Site Recovery, or application-native replication before an exercise validates recovery order.
